offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures water-related products for commercial, institutional and residential buildings, including plumbing fixtures, drinking water systems, flow control and water safety products. Sells mainly through wholesale distributors and reps to contractors, engineers and facility owners.

primary_products.value: drinking fountains and bottle filling stations; commercial faucets, flush valves and sinks; floor and roof drains; water filtration and safety products; backflow preventers and hydrants

customer_segment.value: B2B: plumbing wholesalers, contractors, engineers, building owners, commercial and institutional facilities; B2G: schools, public buildings and municipal projects; B2C: residential consumers via retail, home improvement and online

end_markets.value: commercial construction; education; healthcare; hospitality; municipal and infrastructure; residential

revenue_model.value: product sales: plumbing, drinking water and flow control products sold to distributors and retailers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes water products from purchased materials and components, sold to wholesalers, contractors and retailers; brand owner: owns branded plumbing and drinking water product lines

geography_served.value: global: Primarily US and Canada, with sales in other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: drinking water, hygienic plumbing fixtures, flow control, drainage and water safety products

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: plumbing wholesale distributors and manufacturers' representatives; third-party retail: home improvement retailers for residential drinking water products; online: e-commerce retailers and direct web sales; direct sales: specification to engineers and large accounts
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; online; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: plumbing codes, lead-free and NSF/ANSI standards, ADA accessibility, and product safety certifications
